name: Lemon Arbour
note: Garden seating; the sorrel juice and bakes are the move.

name: Holetown Beach
address: Holetown, north end near the boardwalk
note: Best before 8am; the west coast is famously gentle, late February is fine for a quiet loop.

name: Cuzz's Fish Stand
note: Big plates, lots of sides; order the flying fish cutter.

name: The Tides
note: Plates worth booking ahead; ask for the catch of the day.

name: Second Street nightcap
note: Soft light, no crowds. Better than the main drag for a quiet walk.

name: Lonestar rum shop
note: Skip the highway touts; the side-street rooms are calmer and better value.

name: Bathsheba
note: Free, calm, often missed. Pair with the Soup Bowl surf loop.
